title: Agri Sales Asst Manager - Seed Coating Bio-Polymer
description:
**Company Description**
Yaduka Agrotech Pvt Ltd is East India’s leading integrated supply chain management company in agriculture. The organization operates on a “Farm to Business” model that emphasizes transparency, quality control, and operational efficiency. By using an innovative traceability system, Yaduka Agrotech ensures that produce can be tracked across every stage of the supply chain. The company leverages technology-driven solutions to connect farmers, transporters, cold storages, and wholesalers. This collaborative ecosystem supports a seamless and reliable fruits and vegetables supply chain for business partners.
  
**Role Description**

This role focuses on promoting and selling seed coating bio-polymer products to seed companies, and large corporates, while building long-term relationships with key accounts. Day-to-day responsibilities include identifying new business opportunities, conducting product demonstrations, providing technical support on product usage, and gathering market feedback. The position also involves preparing sales proposals, maintaining accurate sales records, coordinating with supply chain and production teams to ensure timely deliveries, and participating in field visits, exhibitions, and farmer meetings. * Candidates should possess strong interpersonal skills and customer service abilities to build and maintain relationships with seed.companies and other stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess clear communication skills and the ability to explain technical product information in a simple and practical manner.
* Candidates should possess proven sales skills, including lead generation, negotiation, and closing, preferably in agri-inputs or related sectors.
* Candidates should possess solid organizational skills to manage multiple accounts, plan field visits, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Degree or diploma in Agriculture, Agribusiness, or a related field is preferred.
* Knowledge of seed technology, bio-polymers, or crop science will be an advantage.
* Comfort with using digital tools (CRM, spreadsheets, mobile apps) for reporting and communication.
* Ability to travel within the region for field work, meetings, and events as required.

description:
**Company Description**
VGR Precious Metals Private Limited is a premier precious metals enterprise based in Visnagar, Gujarat, serving retail buyers, jewelers, and institutional investors across India. The company operates an advanced precious metals refinery built to BIS refinery standards and a NABL-compliant assay laboratory. VGR specializes in refining, smelting, minting, and trading pure 24K gold (999.0 purity) and silver bullion. Its product portfolio includes high-purity micro-grammage bars, standard investment bars, and industrial bullion. Team members work in a quality-driven environment focused on precision, trust, and regulatory compliance.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Salesperson role based in Visnagar. The Salesperson will engage with retail buyers, jewelers, and institutional clients to promote and sell gold and silver bullion products, including micro-grammage bars and investment bars. Daily responsibilities include identifying new business opportunities, managing existing client relationships, conducting product presentations, and providing accurate information on pricing, purity, and product specifications. The role involves coordinating with refinery and operations teams to ensure timely order fulfillment, maintaining sales records and reports, and supporting marketing initiatives and local promotional activities. The Salesperson is expected to meet sales targets while upholding ethical standards and delivering professional, customer-focused service.

**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and negotiation skills, with demonstrated ability to meet or exceed targets in a B2B or B2C environment.
* Customer relationship management skills, including client communication, follow-up, and after-sales service.
* Basic understanding of precious metals products, bullion markets, or financial/investment products (prior experience in jewelry or bullion sales is an advantage).
* Solid communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English and local languages commonly used in Gujarat.
* Good numerical and analytical skills for handling pricing, discounts, and inventory-related information.
* Ability to work on-site in Visnagar, travel locally as needed, and collaborate effectively with operations and finance teams.
* Proficiency with office and sales tools (e.g., spreadsheets, CRM or sales tracking software, email, and basic reporting).
* Prior experience in sales or business development; a diploma or degree in business, commerce, marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* High level of integrity, attention to detail, and adherence to regulatory and company compliance standards.

Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct

**Role purpose**

This position owns the commercial relationship with every carrier the business uses — rate negotiation, lane allocation, contract renewal and freight cost assurance. It sits directly under the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics and is separate from trade and customs compliance, which is a distinct function. The role carries a monthly express freight spend running in the order of 23 crore, against which no contracted rate table currently exists for the India entities.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own every carrier contract end to end — FedEx across both India entities and the US entity, UPS, Emirates and new entrants — including a renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against every date, so that no term lapses unnoticed.
* Negotiate and benchmark rates, and build the rate card baseline the business does not currently hold. Roughly 89% of monthly freight spend is un-baselined today.
* Own lane allocation — routing volume to the right carrier by cost, transit time and service level — and document the logic so it can be audited and repeated.
* Govern dimensional divisors, fuel and surcharge concessions across all carriers, including the US amendment concessions that expire in February 2027 and revert to list.
* Own freight cost assurance — charged weight against company record, invoice audit before payment, and recovery claims through to credit.
* Drive down accessorial and exception charges by working with operations on root cause, not only by validating them after billing.
* Monitor volume commitments and surge clauses against contractual thresholds, and flag a breach before the carrier does.
* Run carrier governance — quarterly business reviews, SLA reviews, escalation matrices and service remedies.
* Report carrier cost monthly into the business review and into the gross margin programme.
* Support the trade and customs compliance function on carrier-side documentation, without owning compliance itself.

**Required skills, qualifications and experience**

* 10 to 14 years in freight procurement, carrier management or logistics commercial, with direct hands-on negotiation with international express carriers.
* Demonstrated contract negotiation on an annual freight spend of 100 crore or above.
* Deep working knowledge of express pricing mechanics — dimensional divisors, fuel tables, accessorial structures, zone and lane pricing, earned discount tiers and volume commitments.
* Freight audit and recovery experience, including building and defending a claim against a carrier.
* Strong commercial analytics — able to build a cost model, defend it to Finance, and put it in front of a carrier without it being picked apart.
* Exposure across air, ocean and parcel modes; export-led businesses preferred.
* Able to hold a senior carrier relationship and a difficult commercial conversation without damaging it.
* Graduate. MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain, or CIPS or equivalent procurement certification, an advantage.

**What good looks like in the first 90 days**

* A complete rate card and contract baseline across every carrier, in one register.
* A renewal and expiry calendar with a named owner against each date, including the February 2027 surcharge cliff.
* The open recovery claim either closed or on an agreed, dated path with the carrier.
* Lane allocation logic documented and agreed with operations.
* A first view of accessorial spend by type, with the three largest reduction opportunities quantified.
